headline: Foreign media reveal Japanese companies withdrawing from China at unprecedented speed, affected by economic slowdown and strained diplomatic relations | International
summary: A recent survey shows Japanese companies leaving China at a record pace. Firms are reassessing their operations as China's growth slows and China-Japan relations cool.
why: China is the world's second-largest economy, and foreign companies' investment decisions there shape global supply chains and corporate earnings exposure.
